about.markBody: Our mark is the first letter of our name, و, turned four times around a single point. Balanced from every side, like a piece that works wherever the day takes you.
about.nameBody: We chose the name because it describes who we design for: someone who knows himself and doesn't need to prove it. To us, waqar isn't stiffness or formality. It's being at ease in what you wear, and letting that show in how you stand and move.
about.nameDefinition: Calm, self-assured dignity. The kind people notice before you've said a word.
about.openingBody: Waqar is contemporary menswear for men who care how they look but don't need to shout about it. Simple, comfortable pieces, cut with care, made to be worn every day and to feel like you.
about.openingTitle: Good style doesn't need to be loud.
about.principleEaseBody: A knit polo instead of a suit, clean trousers instead of formalwear. Pieces that work for the office and for the evening after it.
about.principleFewerBody: The effort goes into fabric, cut and the small details, so a piece stays with you for many seasons, not just one.
about.principleRootsBody: An Arab identity with a contemporary eye: calm colours, comfortable fabrics, and cuts that belong to now.
about.promiseBody: One team chooses the pieces, checks your order and arranges its delivery. And you only pay once what you ordered is in your hands.
about.returnsBody: Refuse at the door, or start a return from your account after delivery.

faq.afterDelivery.a: Contact Customer Service with your order number. A return goes through approval, collection and inspection before the refund is issued, and any return-shipping fee is agreed with you first.
faq.afterDelivery.q: What if I want to return something after delivery?
faq.cancel.a: You can cancel from your account while the order is still being processed. Once it has been confirmed for delivery, contact Customer Service and they will handle it.
faq.cancel.q: Can I change or cancel an order?
faq.follow.a: Every order moves through five stages: Order Received, Processing, Shipping, Out for Delivery, Delivered. You can watch it from your account, or from Order Tracking with your order number and email.
faq.follow.q: How do I follow my order?
faq.guest.a: Yes. Guest checkout asks only for your name, email, phone and delivery address. You can look the order up later on the Order Tracking page with your order number and that email address.
faq.guest.q: Can I order without an account?
faq.pay.a: Cash on delivery, always. We never ask for card details and no payment is taken before your order reaches you.
faq.refuse.a: Yes — you can refuse the whole order or part of it at the door, and only pay for what you keep.
faq.shipping.a: By where you are. Pick your governorate, city, district and area at checkout and the store returns the rate configured for the most specific level that has one — you never type or adjust a shipping price yourself.
footer.codBody: Pay in cash when your order reaches your door — no card details are ever collected.
